resolutions.researcher_notes: Status = operating. The Qatif project (incl. Berri Gas Plant expansion to sweeten Qatif sour gas) was completed/onstream in 2005-2009; both sources describe it as a producing/completed facility with Qatif gas routed to Berri Gas Plant. Two independent industry/reference sources agree. No contradiction; long-operating asset.

Fuel = Gas. Offshore-technology: 'gas from the Qatif field is sent to the Berri Gas Plant'; Wikipedia Qatif Project: ~370 MMcf/d of associated natural gas produced, routed to Berri Gas Plant. Two independent sources confirm the line carries gas.

LengthKnown = 45.00 km NOT corroborated. Searched OGJ, MEED, Offshore Technology, Oil&Gas Advancement, Wikipedia, OPEC ASB2012 (seed cite; scratch PDF was image-only/text-empty). Related Qatif/Berri contracts cite other lengths (28 km GOSP-GOSP line; 50 km/42-in Abu Sa'fah trunkline; 30-in 23.98 km + 20-in 10.23 km Saipem CRPO-162), none matching a 45 km Qatif North->Berri gas line. 45 km appears to be a GEM-internal estimate; no independent public source verifies it. Not fabricating a URL.

Diameter = 32 in NOT corroborated. Qatif/Berri contract reporting cites 12-30-in oil/water lines, a 30-in and 20-in Saipem pair, and a 42-in Abu Sa'fah trunkline, but no independent source gives a 32-in diameter for the Qatif North->Berri gas line. Appears to be a GEM-internal estimate; no public source verifies. Not fabricating a URL.
FuelSource = Qatif. Both sources state the gas originates in the Qatif field and is sent to Berri Gas Plant. Two independent sources agree.

Location endpoints supported: Qatif field (Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia) -> Berri Gas Plant. Offshore-technology places the Berri Gas Plant in al-Jubayl (Al Jubail) Industrial City, Eastern Province; Wikipedia Qatif Project confirms Qatif, Eastern Province and gas routed to Berri. Both endpoints and the Eastern Province / Al Jubail geography corroborated by two independent sources.

Owner1 = Saudi Aramco 100%. The Qatif project, Berri Gas Plant and associated pipelines are Saudi Aramco assets; both sources identify Saudi Aramco as the developer/operator (national oil company, wholly state-owned Qatif development). No third-party ownership indicated. Two independent sources agree.
